name: Mustang Panda
affiliation_detail:
Attributed to the PRC government by January 2025 U.S. DOJ court authorised operation, which stated "the PRC government paid the Mustang Panda group to, among other computer intrusion services, develop ... specific version of PlugX." 
No specific PLA unit, MSS bureau, or contractor has been publicly named. No individuals have been indicted.
description:
According to U.S. DOJ documents, Mustang Panda is Chinese state-aligned espionage group active since at least 2012. The group targets government, diplomatic, NGO, religious, think tank, and research organizations across the U.S., Europe, and Asia, with particular focus on countries along China's periphery and entities relevant to Chinese strategic interests.
The group frequently utilizes tool PlugX, a modular RAT shared across Chinese groups since 2008 but deployed by Mustang Panda in customized variants, including a USB-propagating version that targets air-gapped networks. (Trend Micro, 2024)
 
In January 2025, FBI/DOJ/French law enforcement, together with the French cybersecurity company Sekoia.io,  launched the operation to delete PlugX from computers worldwide. Approximately 4,258 U.S. computers were cleaned.
Mustang Panda is highly reactive to geopolitical events, which are exploited for its initial access vector through phishing lures: Vatican and Catholic organizations during China-Vatican negotiations (2020); governments during the Ukraine invasion (2022);  ASEAN-Australia Summit attendees (2024); Thailand military during the Thailand-Cambodia border conflict (2025); and U.S. policy organizations using Venezuela-themed lures (January 2026).
In June 2026, Acronis reported that Mustang Panda targeted India's government and energy sectors with two newly identified malware tools. The spear phishing lure used exploited existing hydropower cooperation between India and Taiwan. (Acronis, 2026)

campaigns.name: Vatican and Catholic Organization Targeting
campaigns.description: Recorded Future documented RedDelta targeting the Vatican and Catholic organizations during China-Vatican diplomatic negotiations. PlugX delivered via tailored spear-phishing.

sources.title: Chinese State-Sponsored Group RedDelta Targets the Vatican and Catholic Organizations

campaigns.name: European Government Targeting (Ukraine Escalation)
campaigns.description: Proofpoint documented TA416 increasing operational tempo against European governments as the Ukraine conflict escalated. Used European Commission-themed lures and PlugX variants. Also targeted European shipping companies in 2024.

campaigns.name: Thailand Military Targeting (SnakeDisk)
campaigns.description: Geo-fenced SnakeDisk USB worm targeting Thai government and military during Thailand-Cambodia border tensions. Payload activated only on Thai IP addresses. Delivered Yokai backdoor.

campaigns.name: U.S. Policy Organization Targeting (Venezuela Lures)
campaigns.description: Reuters reported Mustang Panda using Venezuela-themed spear-phishing to target U.S. government and policy organizations following U.S. operations involving Venezuelan President Maduro.
